note: RV park at the Dodge County Fairgrounds, run by the nonprofit Dodge County Fair Association, about 4 miles east of Beaver Dam on Highway 33; it sells nights all season, not just during events (the fairgrounds hosts events most weekends). Sites are on grass except 4 full-hookup sites on gravel and 3 paved 50-amp sites; the rest have 50- or 30-amp electric and water. --Claude
